# Data Source: identitynow_oauth_client

Use this data source to look up an OAuth (API) client by ID. The client secret is not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_oauth_client" "ci" {
  id = "2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) OAuth client ID.

### Read-Only

- `access_token_validity_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds an access token is valid for.
- `access_type` (String) Access type, `ONLINE` or `OFFLINE`.
- `business_name` (String) Name of the business the API client belongs to.
- `claims_supported` (Boolean) Whether the API client supports the serialization of SAML claims.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the API client.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the API client is enabled.
- `grant_types` (Set of String) OAuth 2.0 grant types the client can be used with.
- `homepage_url` (String) Homepage URL associated with the owner of the API client.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the API client can be used for requests internal to IdentityNow.
- `last_used` (String) Date the client was last used to generate an access token. It is updated once a day.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the API client.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Approved redirect URIs.
- `refresh_token_validity_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds a refresh token is valid for.
- `scope` (Set of String) Scopes of the API client.
- `strong_auth_supported` (Boolean) Whether the API client supports strong authentication.
- `type` (String) Client type, `CONFIDENTIAL` or `PUBLIC`.
